name: Mum's Apricot Chicken
description: Oven-baked chicken coated in flour and pepper, simmered in apricot nectar and French onion soup.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 170°C fan forced.
Put the chicken, flour, and pepper in a freezer bag and shake to coat the chicken.
Heat the apricot nectar and French onion soup powder in a microwave, stirring occasionally until hot.
Spray an oven-proof dish, then add the chicken and apricot mixture.
Bake for around 90 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
